reading: A claim is counted as carrying an uncounted crash only if the instrumented re-run OBSERVED a crash under it. A claim the re-run never reached is reported separately and is NOT folded into the clean column -- 'no crash was recorded' and 'no crash happened' are the two things this whole ticket exists to keep apart, and collapsing them here would be the same error one level up.
